neighbours.label: devotional Christian phrasing that sets up divine light or love: the token after 'God' ('s, is) or after 'the light' ('of'), predicting light/love/life; as against the same religious register without the light/love setup and secular 'of' phrases
fire: Our volunteers hope to show God's love to every family who walks through the door.
The pastor reminded us that Christ is the light of the world, even in hard times.
As the hymn says, God is love, and whoever abides in love abides in him.
We gather each Sunday to celebrate God's grace and share it with our neighbours.
The Advent candle reminds the children that Jesus is the light of the nations.
John's letter teaches that God is light and there is no darkness in him.
May the light of Christ guide you through the coming year.
Missionaries travelled far to spread the message of God's love to strangers.
quiet: Our volunteers hope to give a warm coat to every family who walks through the door.
The pastor reminded us that the roof repairs will start in early spring.
As the hymn ends, the choir sits down and the organist plays softly.
We gather each Sunday to drink coffee and talk with our neighbours.
The Advent calendar reminds the children how many days are left until the holiday.
Paul's letter was written while he was held in prison in Rome.
The minutes of the parish meeting were read aloud by the secretary.
Missionaries travelled far to build schools and wells in remote villages.
